CustomField.description: What inline edits are displayed: - empty (default): setting from Checklist (all, task, record, none) - all: any fields defined in FieldSet (ChecklistInlineEdit) on Task or Record - task: show only Task fieldsets - record: show only record fieldsets - none: no inline edit for Tasks of this Item - comma-separated list of fields to show, e.g. Task.Priority, Upload()
